assertion_checks.description: Q6: Net Revenue YoY % (Like-for-like) + Net Revenue YoY % (New Titles) must equal Net Revenue YoY % exactly -- both terms share the same denominator (the full prior-year total), so the decomposition is additive by construction. Both sides computed live from source, not from rounded/hardcoded literals; the identity (LLF_cur-LLF_py)+(Total_cur-LLF_cur) = Total_cur-Total_py holds exactly once both fractions share the Total_py denominator.
assertion_checks.sql_left: WITH d AS (SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(net_usd AS REAL)),0) FROM fact_order WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(net_refund_usd AS REAL)),0) FROM fact_refund WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31') AS cur_total, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(net_usd AS REAL)),0) FROM fact_order WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(net_refund_usd AS REAL)),0) FROM fact_refund WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31') AS py_total, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(net_usd AS REAL)),0) FROM fact_order WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31' AND title_id IN ('T-01','T-03','T-04')) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(net_refund_usd AS REAL)),0) FROM fact_refund WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31' AND title_id IN ('T-01','T-03','T-04')) AS llf_cur, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(net_usd AS REAL)),0) FROM fact_order WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31' AND title_id IN ('T-01','T-03','T-04')) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(net_refund_usd AS REAL)),0) FROM fact_refund WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31' AND title_id IN ('T-01','T-03','T-04')) AS llf_py) SELECT (llf_cur - llf_py) / llf_py * 100 + (cur_total - llf_cur) / py_total * 100 FROM d

Regression test for the Session 1 bug: comparing TEXT-typed amount columns without CAST made SQLite do lexical string comparison and reported 1,883 false 'over-refunds'. With CAST, must be 0.
assertion_checks.sql_left: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_refund r JOIN fact_order o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE CAST(r.net_refund_usd AS REAL) > CAST(o.net_usd AS REAL) + 0.005

assertion_checks.description: All net_refund_usd values are positive (measures subtract this column; if the warehouse ever shipped a negative refund, Net Revenue would silently add it back)
assertion_checks.sql_left: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_refund WHERE CAST(net_refund_usd AS REAL) < 0

assertion_checks.description: fact_refund's own title_id/player_id/platform_code/order_date must still agree with the parent fact_order on every row -- the basis for routing fact_refund through the shared dimensions instead of through fact_order
assertion_checks.sql_left: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_refund f JOIN fact_order o ON f.order_id = o.order_id WHERE f.title_id <> o.title_id OR f.player_id <> o.player_id OR f.platform_code <> o.platform_code OR f.order_date <> o.order_date
